description:
Use this when you need an auditable Pakistan working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide federal public-holiday layer only. It is not a universal provincial, territory, private-employer, bank, exchange, school, court, diplomatic-mission or sector calendar. Lunar festival dates are pinned to the later federal notifications available for 2026; conflicting exchange or diplomatic calendars are retained as scoped cross-checks and not generalized.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Pakistan working days around Pakistan Day. | Count Pakistan working days around Ordinary federal working day.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-05-26","end_date":"2026-05-28","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/pakistan-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/pakistan-public-working-days-between.md
name: count_pk_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Pakistan 2026 nationwide federal public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday federal-office baseline

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

substitute_day_policy.description: published_federal_dates_only; no automatic weekend_lieu_day; lunar dates and later Cabinet notifications override the annual estimate

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Pakistan Working Days
